cover.headline: [5] types of girls you should stay [away] from

picked.why: Unimpressed attitude, eyeroll-vibe, pouty expression—perfect opener for 'types to avoid.' Bold and scroll-stopping without trying.

slides: Not every girl with tattoos is a red flag, but a lot of them are. Heavy tattoos and wild energy often come with chaos, attention addiction and an “I don't care” attitude that will drain you. Choose carefully.
If she follows thousands of random guys, she's not looking for one man. She's collecting attention. Her DMs are always full, and you're just another option on her list.
No education. No skills. No goals. Nothing going on in her life except looking pretty and waiting for a man to fix everything. You'll end up carrying her whole life on your back.
She only talks about money, gifts, trips and “what can you do for me.” If she's more interested in your wallet than your personality, run. You'll never be enough for her.
5. The girl with a high body count
A high body count usually means low standards and emotional baggage. She's given her body to many men, and now she wants loyalty from you. Don't be the guy who tries to “fix” her.
closing: Save this before you get attached.
caption:
5 types of girls you should stay away from.

The tattoo girl with chaos energy. The girl following 1,000+ guys. The girl with no ambition. The gold digger. The girl with a high body count.

Which one have you met?
